description: This file defines classes and functions for analyzing memory dependencies within the Torch JIT tensor expression framework, including AccessInfo and MemDependencyChecker classes, dependency graph construction, and dependency queries.

classes.name: AccessInfo
classes.description: Represents a single memory access (load, store, etc.) with dependency links.

classes.name: MemDependencyChecker
classes.description: Analyzes IR fragments to build and query memory dependency graphs.

methods.name: AccessInfo
methods.description: Constructs an AccessInfo object with specified parameters.

methods.name: getIndices
methods.description: Returns symbolic index expressions of the access.

methods.name: addDependency
methods.description: Establishes a dependency relationship with another access.

methods.name: addDependent
methods.description: Establishes a dependent relationship with another access.

methods.name: hasDependency
methods.description: Checks if this access has a dependency on another.

methods.name: getDirectDependencies
methods.description: Returns immediate dependencies of this access.

methods.name: getDirectDependents
methods.description: Returns immediate dependents of this access.

methods.name: getIndirectDependencies
methods.description: Returns all dependencies in the dependency chain.

methods.name: getIndirectDependents
methods.description: Returns all dependents in the dependency chain.

methods.name: isRead
methods.description: Checks if the access is a read operation.

methods.name: isWrite
methods.description: Checks if the access is a write operation.

methods.name: dumpDAG
methods.description: Outputs the dependency graph in DOT format.
